analysis.summary: Akiko Global Services Limited reported healthy growth in Q1 FY27, driven by core business expansion and the development of its digital platform, AkikoPay. Management expressed confidence in achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of INR325 crore to INR350 crore and maintaining a PAT margin of 9% to 11%. The company is transitioning to a hybrid model by integrating its offline distribution network with digital financial services. Management also confirmed plans to scale its branch network and continue its focus on profitability and long-term value creation. Akiko Global Services Limited reported strong Q1 FY27 financial performance, with revenue reaching ₹6,812.2 lakhs and a PAT of ₹701.6 lakhs.

guidance.claim: The company revised its FY27 revenue guidance to INR325 crore to INR350 crore.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects a PAT margin of 9% to 11% for the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

guidance.claim: The company targets a CAGR of 70% to 100% over the next three years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve revenue of ₹300–325 crore for FY27.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: The company targets revenue of INR 300 crores or more for FY27.
guidance.quote: I am expecting my outlook for 2027 is INR300 crores. That is not going below INR300 crores, this is going to be above INR300 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects 70% to 100% revenue growth for FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: The company targets INR 1,000 crores in revenue by 2030 with PAT margins of 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q1 FY27 revenue between INR 65 crores and INR 70 crores.
guidance.quote: I am expecting INR65 crores to something in between crores in Q1.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing healthy demand for its core business and credit products.
demand_outlook.quote: Bank partnerships are strong, and the sourcing pipeline is healthy, due to which we see good visibility for the upcoming quarters as well.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is experiencing 4% to 7% month-on-month growth in its core offline business.
demand_outlook.quote: So, we highly value everyone's trust. Many investors place great trust in us and we will continue to work with full commitment going forward. Whatever commitment we make, we will fulfill it. So thank you everyone, and I would now be happy to take your questions.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing healthy user engagement trends on AkikoPay.
demand_outlook.quote: And user engagement trends are also very healthy.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that physical presence significantly improves lead conversion rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Where our digital conversion rate is 10%, with physical presence, that conversion reaches 60% to 80%, which we have felt over the last two years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to reach a total of 25 branches this year.
capex_expansion.quote: There is a plan for 25 branches in total.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is currently rolling out the iOS version of its AkikoPay platform.
capex_expansion.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has expanded its branch presence to 16 cities.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean, where we had three or four branches in the last quarter, today we have 16 branches across India.

margins_costs.claim: Management aims to increase PAT margins to 12% to 14% next year if AkikoPay performs well.
margins_costs.quote: If AkikoPay works very well, next year that will go up to 12% to 14%.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintains a disciplined cost structure for its AkikoPay platform.
margins_costs.quote: Disciplined cost structure with controlled operating burn

margins_costs.claim: Q4 margins were impacted by planned investments in branch expansion and technology.
margins_costs.quote: This was due to our planned investment towards branch expansion, this was the most important thing, in which some of our money has been spent on that. Some of our money has been spent in technology infrastructure, on the AkikoPay scale-up initiative.

margins_costs.claim: Dubai operations faced temporary margin pressure due to geopolitical issues.
margins_costs.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

orders_capacity.claim: The company aims to reach INR1,000 crore in monthly loan disbursements by the end of Q3.
orders_capacity.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursals have increased to over ₹450 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently disburses over 16,000 credit cards monthly.
orders_capacity.quote: If we talk about the credit card segment, which used to be our core business at one time, today we successfully disburse 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.

orders_capacity.claim: The loan book has reached an annual run rate of INR 5,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has no plans for fundraising for the next 6 to 12 months.
capital_allocation.quote: No, sir. There is absolutely no plan for fundraising right now. Even banks are supporting us very well. So, our CC limits are well aligned. So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Dubai business faced revenue pressure in Q1 due to war.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's forward-looking statements are subject to various risks including economic performance, competition, and technological changes.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the company’s ability to successfully implement its strategy, the Company’s future levels of growth and expansion, technological implementation, changes and advancements, changes in revenue, income or cash flows, the Company’s market preferences and its exposure to market risks, as well as other risks.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in the Iran region impacted Dubai operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

management_commitments.claim: The company will integrate insurance and mutual funds into the AkikoPay platform within two months.
management_commitments.quote: After that version, our integration of insurance and mutual funds will begin. That will take 2 months.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to reduce receivable days to within 90 days in Q2.
management_commitments.quote: In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to hire a CEO to strengthen management.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next 2 months -- 3 months, as you mentioned, those positions will be filled.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore.
management_commitments.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to reach 1 million AkikoPay customers by the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: I am expecting 5 lakh customers by 30th of September and 1 million customers till 31st December.

management_commitments.claim: Ankur Gaba will likely take the MD position in the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: Most likely in the next one or two months. I have already spoken with my management. They did agreed. So, we'll take a -- we'll take a decision very soon and in the next quarter, you will see me as an MD.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
